motion.geometryPolicy: Original connected CAD meshes and material slots; object transforms only.
motion.seekPolicy: Absolute transforms from saved source matrices; source pose at progress 0 and 1.

leadscrew.calibration: Four-start helical periodicity and axial pitch recovered from the staged source screw surface; normalized scene distances.

motion.motion: Horizontal gantry rises on its vertical guide rods while the complete tool carriage travels along the two horizontal rails, then both return.
motion.limitations: A conservative demonstration stroke within the modeled rail travel; it does not specify programmed machine travel, speed or tool operation.

cameraTracking: Original source camera position and direction
